svg.title: Attendance and working hours — SoftTrack web design mockup (#252)
svg.desc: Two needs share this issue: knowing whether it is a reasonable hour to ask somebody something, and a record of when people worked. Working hours and timezone are set by the person on their profile and shown to colleagues; clocking in and out is an instance setting, off by default, with a monthly summary for the person, their manager and HR.
svg.text: · two needs, one small and one optional

No location tracking, no screenshots, no activity monitoring, and
no link to worklogs: time logged on tickets says what the work
cost, not whether somebody was at their desk.

svg.text: Done when a person can set their timezone, working days and usual hours and the profile shows the time where they are; reminders and summaries use the timezone; an instance
setting turns attendance on, and with it off nothing about it exists; with it on a person clocks in and out from the header, a forgotten clock-out is closed with a note and marked as
edited, and the person, their manager and HR see a monthly summary.
